historical_record.description: A wood and metal warehouse was built for the Dyer Brothers Iron Works, which stayed until 1935.
Fraser and Johnson Gas Furnace and Metal Products took the site over from the Dyer Brothers Iron Works and held it until 1972.
The warehouse, latterly a solid-waste recycling and transfer station, and the two-storey office building with it were both vacated.
